description: Replace the OTHER artists a track is billed to: the "Artist & Guest feat. Guest" line on every store. The account's own artist is always billed first and cannot be removed. Do not send it (a name equal to it is dropped, never printed twice). Send the others in billing order. `primary` and `with` join the main credit after the account's artist; `featured` and `remixer` become the "feat." part. Another `primary` artist is a collaboration: ask the artist whether they have all the rights needed for it, and send rights_confirmed: true only when they say yes. Without it the call is refused and nothing is written. `featured`, `with` and `remixer` need no confirmation. Optional: a track with none is billed to the artist profile's own name. The songwriter, performer and producer credits are a different list, set with set_track_credits.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

artists.description: The artists besides the account's own, in billing order. An empty list clears the billing back to the artist's own name.

name.description: Exactly as it should read on the store.

dry_run.description: True to check the call and see what it would replace, without writing anything.

rights_confirmed.description: Required as true when the list has a `primary` artist besides the account's own. Ask the artist first, in these words: "I have all the rights needed for this collaboration". Send true only when they confirm it. Never assume it: it is recorded as their legal confirmation.

name: set_track_artists
title: Set who a track is billed to
